content: ApprovalTests (multi-language, incl. C++) writes actual output to a .received file, compares to a checked-in .approved file; on mismatch launches a diff-tool reporter. Accepting a change = overwriting .received onto .approved (a manual, explicit step, typically via the diff tool's 'accept' action) and committing the new .approved file. No implicit auto-accept in CI; matches the 'baseline is git-tracked, promotion is explicit' pattern mediadiff's *.snap.json workflow should follow.
